messages.text:
Design proposes the following replacement wording.

**Permitted use and access.** The testing house may use the actuator drawings and CAD geometry solely to prepare for, conduct and report on the agreed vibration tests. Access is limited to test personnel identified by name and role in a list approved in writing by Design. The testing house may propose additions or substitutions by email. Each person, including any external specialist, must be bound by confidentiality and use restrictions at least as protective as this agreement before receiving access. The testing house remains responsible for their compliance. Neither the testing house nor anyone receiving the material may reuse it to develop a competing product.

**Working copies and fixtures.** The testing house may make the working copies reasonably needed for the tests, provided digital copies are encrypted in transit and at rest and accessible only to approved personnel. It may extract the minimum geometry needed to design and fabricate fixtures for these tests. The same access and use limits apply to fixture files and physical fixtures. The final report may retain measurements and test results. Including CAD geometry or dimensioned views requires Design’s prior written approval.

**Destruction and verification.** Within 15 business days after Design accepts the final test report in writing, or after earlier termination of the test engagement, the testing house must delete the supplied drawings, CAD files, working copies and geometry-bearing fixture files, and destroy the physical fixtures made from that geometry. It must provide a written certificate covering its own holdings and those of approved external personnel. Design will accept certification by an independent verifier in place of site access. The verifier may review deletion and disposal records without receiving the CAD geometry.

Can your lab certify deletion within that period, including from instrument storage and backups? If a backup cycle or accreditation requirement prevents that, please identify the specific material, required retention period and access controls so we can agree on a narrow exception.

We can certify deletion of the supplied drawings, CAD, working copies, geometry-bearing fixture files and instrument working storage within 15 business days. We will not put those files on general backup. The only retention we must keep is calibration and accreditation records for two years, with geometry removed. We will not accept site access, announced or unannounced, at a shared customer facility.

**Permitted use and access.** The testing house may use the actuator drawings and CAD geometry solely to prepare for, conduct and report the agreed vibration tests. Access is limited to named test personnel and to personnel of the accredited laboratory and the specialist machining shop engaged for these tests, each identified by name and role on a list exchanged before work starts. A person of the same role who is already bound by confidentiality and use restrictions at least as protective as this agreement may be substituted during the job on email notice before access; Design may object within one business day, except that a substitution required to keep a test already under way may take effect on notice, with confirmation to follow. The testing house remains responsible for compliance. The material may not be reused to develop a competing product.

**Working copies and fixtures.** Working copies reasonably needed for the tests are permitted if digital copies are encrypted in transit and at rest and limited to approved personnel. The testing house may isolate the minimum geometry needed to design and fabricate fixtures and may share only that extract with the machining shop. Fixture files and physical fixtures are under the same limits. The final report may keep measurements and results. CAD geometry or dimensioned views require Design’s prior written approval.

**Destruction and verification.** Within 15 business days after written acceptance of the final report, or earlier termination, the testing house will delete the supplied drawings, CAD, working copies and geometry-bearing fixture files, clear instrument working storage of that geometry, and destroy physical fixtures made from it. It will certify its own holdings and those of the laboratory and machining shop. Calibration and accreditation records may be kept for two years if they contain no drawing or CAD geometry, are access-limited to quality personnel, and are not used to reconstruct the design. Design will not inspect the shared site. An independent verifier may review deletion, disposal and calibration-record descriptions off site, or in a records review that does not expose other customers’ work, and will not receive CAD geometry.

Attachments should be the personnel and shop list, the confidentiality form, and the deletion certificate. If that substitution notice and the two-year non-geometry calibration hold are acceptable, we can close on this text.

Design accepts the two-year retention of geometry-free calibration and accreditation records on the terms proposed. We also accept certification covering the testing house, laboratory and machining shop, with independent records review and no Design access to the shared site. Please include the agreed backup restriction in the destruction clause: “The testing house shall ensure that the supplied drawings, CAD, working copies and geometry-bearing fixture files are excluded from general backups at all three organizations.”

For substitutions, Design can accept a one-business-day objection period. For a test already under way, please name alternates in advance so they can take over immediately. We propose replacing the personnel-list and substitution sentences with the following wording.

“Before work starts, the parties shall agree by email on a list identifying each person authorized to access the material, including alternates, by name, organization and role. Before access, every listed person must be bound by confidentiality and use restrictions at least as protective as this agreement. A listed alternate may take over the agreed role immediately on email notice to Design. For an unlisted replacement, the testing house shall email Design the person’s name, organization and role and confirm that the same restrictions bind them. Access may begin on Design’s written approval or, if Design raises no objection, one business day after receipt of notice. If Design objects within that period, the replacement requires Design’s written approval before access. Every replacement remains subject to the access limits for their role and organization.”

Design accepts the balance of your wording and the three proposed attachments. These edits would resolve our remaining points.

We accept the personnel and substitution wording, including named alternates who may take over immediately on email notice and a one-business-day objection period for any unlisted replacement. We will put alternates for the testing house, the accredited laboratory and the machining shop on the list before work starts.

**Destruction and verification.** Within 15 business days after written acceptance of the final report, or earlier termination, the testing house will delete the supplied drawings, CAD, working copies and geometry-bearing fixture files, clear instrument working storage of that geometry, and destroy physical fixtures made from it. The testing house shall ensure that the supplied drawings, CAD, working copies and geometry-bearing fixture files are excluded from general backups at all three organizations. It will certify its own holdings and those of the laboratory and machining shop. Calibration and accreditation records may be kept for two years if they contain no drawing or CAD geometry, are access-limited to quality personnel, and are not used to reconstruct the design. Design will not inspect the shared site. An independent verifier may review deletion, disposal and calibration-record descriptions off site, or in a records review that does not expose other customers’ work, and will not receive CAD geometry.

Attachments remain the personnel and shop list, the confidentiality form, and the deletion certificate. With the accepted use, copy, fixture and substitution text, these points are closed.

Design requests a narrow addendum for the prototype batch. Only the geometry on page 4 of the affected drawing is export-restricted. We propose the following wording.

“Design will identify the affected drawing by number and revision and issue a test copy with the page 4 geometry removed, including from any embedded CAD data. Design will retain the restricted geometry. The testing house, laboratory and machining shop may continue work using the cleared files. If any recipient already holds a copy containing the restricted geometry, it must isolate that copy, prevent further access or transfer, and notify Design so we can arrange secure deletion and confirmation.

“For the test step that relies on page 4, Design will supply a reference coupon cleared for use by the named personnel. Design needs two days from written agreement on the verification test to prepare the coupon. Before using it for the actuator test, the laboratory will run a low-level vibration sweep on the agreed fixture, measure the response at the agreed sensor locations and compare it with a response envelope supplied by Design. The parties will agree by email on the sweep range and level, sensor locations and numerical pass limits before coupon preparation begins. The laboratory will record the result in the test report and proceed with the affected step only after a pass. All other agreed terms continue to apply.”

Please confirm whether any recipient already holds the affected page or its CAD equivalent, and whether the proposed sweep can verify the coupon for your setup. If so, please send the usable sweep range, excitation level and sensor locations so Design can propose matching pass limits.

The machining shop already holds fixture stock cut from the earlier extract, and may hold that extract. It does not need page 4. Any file containing that page or its CAD equivalent will be isolated, with no further access or transfer, and deleted under the agreed certificate. The cut stock stays at the shop under the existing fixture limits and is not a copy of page 4.

We cannot set a sweep range, excitation level or sensor locations, and we will not treat a low-level sweep as the verification. The test lead can measure Design’s reference coupon at the testing house and send the shop only a tolerance table. That works only if Design specifies the tolerances and accepts a repeatability check.

**Restricted geometry and coupon.** Design will identify the affected drawing by number and revision and issue a test copy with page 4 removed, including from embedded CAD. Design retains the restricted geometry. Cleared files may be used as already agreed. Any recipient that already holds page 4 or its CAD equivalent will isolate it, stop further access or transfer, and delete it under the agreed certificate. Cut fixture stock may remain at the machining shop; it will not be copied, measured back into CAD, or transferred.

**Verification, custody and signoff.** Design will specify the tolerances in writing and supply one reference coupon cleared for named testing-house personnel. Design has two business days from written agreement on those tolerances to deliver the coupon to the testing house. Custody stays with the testing house until the affected step is signed off; the shop receives only the tolerance table, not the coupon or page 4. The test lead will measure the coupon, repeat the measurement once, and send the table only if both results fall inside Design’s tolerances. The laboratory records the check and proceeds only after that pass. A failed check stops the affected step for written signoff by both parties. All other agreed terms continue to apply.

If Design specifies the tolerances and accepts this check, custody and two-day delivery, the addendum can close on this text.

Design accepts the repeatability check, testing-house custody and delivery of one cleared coupon within two business days after written agreement on the tolerances. Design will specify the acceptance limits for each measurement in writing. The pass criterion is that each of the two readings independently meets its applicable limits.

Please add this sentence to the verification clause: “Design will approve the shop-facing tolerance table in writing before release, confirming that it contains no restricted geometry or information from which that geometry can be reconstructed. After a pass, the test lead may send only that approved table to the named shop personnel.” This approval can take place when we agree on the tolerances.

Design accepts the remaining wording, including retention of the cut stock under the agreed fixture limits. Please confirm the table-release sentence and have the shop verify whether it holds the earlier extract, without opening or transmitting it. If its contents are uncertain, the shop should treat it as restricted, isolate it and include its deletion in the agreed certificate.

We confirm the table-release sentence and will add it to the verification clause: “Design will approve the shop-facing tolerance table in writing before release, confirming that it contains no restricted geometry or information from which that geometry can be reconstructed. After a pass, the test lead may send only that approved table to the named shop personnel.” That approval may be given with the written tolerances. Each of the two readings must independently meet the limits Design specifies.

The shop has checked custody without opening or transmitting any earlier extract. It cannot confirm the contents, so it will treat the file as restricted, isolate it from general storage and shop systems, and include its deletion in the agreed certificate covering the testing house, laboratory and machining shop. No copy will be sent to Design or the verifier.

The repeatability check stays in testing-house custody. One cleared coupon will be delivered within two business days after written agreement on the tolerances. Cut stock remains under the agreed fixture limits. Site access, backup exclusion, two-year geometry-free calibration records, and substitution terms are unchanged. With this sentence and the isolated extract, the attachments and verification points are closed.
